title: Add ia kit check
summary: `ia kit check [<folder>...]` checks kit folders against the kit spec in one run. An integrity finding always fails: the descriptor, release history, recorded sources and sidecars disagree, a `works` range is unreadable, two kits share an id, or a release's version understates its change (a removed record, a dropped key or a higher IA minimum needs a major step; an added record or key a minor step; one step down on 0.x). A spec finding (no format 2 release naming `works`, README, tests, seat workspace, offered key, licence or source commit, or a dependency outside the kit's layer) is reported for a kit on 0.x and fails a kit at 1.0.0 or above. `@inventarch/runtime/method` exports the checker as `checkKit` and `checkKits`.
